node.statement: Write H_{A,B}(U):=(Ha^Q_{A,B})_n(U). For every column X the following identity is exact by adding and subtracting compressed multiplications: [H_{P,R}(Z dot W)-H_{P,S}(Z)H_{S,R}(W)]X = [H_{P,R}(Z dot W)X-(Z dot W) dot X]+[(Z dot W) dot X-Z dot(W dot X)]+Z dot[W dot X-H_{S,R}(W)X]+[Z dot H_{S,R}(W)X-H_{P,S}(Z)H_{S,R}(W)X].
